calls.statement:
SELECT s.format, count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_lines,
 count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_ids, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_lines,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores,
 min(f.sale_date) AS mind, max(f.sale_date) AS maxd, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, s.store_id, s.format AS fmt_then, cs.format AS fmt_now
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4)
SELECT 'all_incl_staff' AS k, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS r, sum(net_amount) AS n, sum(CASE WHEN fmt_then<>fmt_now THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fmt_changed FROM base
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ctrl_rpt', sum(receipts), sum(net_sales_before_returns), NULL FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
 WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id<900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'atv_'||fmt_now, count(DISTINCT receipt_id), sum(net_amount), round(sum(net_amount)/count(DISTINCT receipt_id),2) FROM base WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag GROUP BY fmt_now
